Methods of Reforestation

A practical path from seed to thriving forest.

Step 1

Seed Selection

Choosing the right seeds is crucial for successful reforestation.

Step 2

Site Preparation

Preparing the land for planting, including clearing and soil enhancement.

Step 3

Planting

Carefully planting seeds or saplings in the prepared areas.

Step 4

Maintenance

Regular care including watering, weeding, and monitoring growth.

Our Mission

Growing resilient ecosystems for the future.

We work with communities, volunteers, and local stakeholders to restore native landscapes, improve biodiversity, and create long-term environmental resilience.

  • Native tree plantation and biodiversity restoration
  • Community-led sustainability education and action
  • Long-term ecosystem monitoring and care
